column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only lesson memory of recipe planner-cycle-fix-20261107 (PLANNER_CYCLE_FIX): one row per lesson, appended in the same commit as the correction.

column4: the cycle contract comes from the exact paths, not from a new rule: the brute-force reference and the exact search keep only dependency-closed sets, so a cycle is planned as a whole group; the greedy fix therefore visits each capability once (the group joins together) instead of refusing cyclic catalogues the exact search already plans
column5: dump: 238 cyclic brute-force plans equal the planner before and after the fix

column4: the fix lands on a relocated file, so the relocation recipe must accept it: relocate.py v5 PATCH rows pin this recipe's before (the relocated bytes) and after; the class-identity gate takes a declared pattern because the added javadoc lines shift the line tables of the planner's nested classes ($Closure, $Search) without changing their code
column5: class_identity: 5 declared CHANGED (planner x3, dump x2), 220 identical

column4: keeping the acyclic corpus byte-identical needs the new cyclic catalogues on a separate seed after the main loop and the catalogue generator's random draws unchanged for the main loop (cyclicGreedy flag defaults to the old acyclic draw); the probe and cyclic lines then differ only where the fix intends
column5: base vs head PLAN/TUPLE/HASH lines IDENTICAL on JIT (5,250 lines) and -Xint (788 lines)

column4: a mutant without the visited check never ends on a cycle (the explicit stack grows without bound); the gate runs every mutant under a 120 s and -Xmx256m bound and counts the bound as a kill
column5: no-visited-check: KILLED by the 120 s bound
